title: bromus squarrosus var. normalis
intro: Bromus squarrosus var. normalis, commonly known as Red Brome, is a perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Red Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and immunomodulatory activities.
